_comment: Single source of truth for projects.html and backlog.html. Edit this, then run: python3 build_projects.py

projects.name: Tutor
projects.summary: Converts arbitrary datasets into chunked learning material with multiple-choice knowledge checks (FSRS spaced repetition planned).

milestones.note: Rapid iteration on the conversion pipeline.
First builds: dataset -> chunked lessons -> MCQ checks.

projects.name: Sentry
projects.summary: High-priority alert service: emergency weather (typhoon / earthquake), plus email keyword monitoring.

milestones.note: Distributed via the F-Droid repo.
First packaged build.

projects.name: Anetmon
projects.summary: Network monitor — traffic logging and analysis. Descends from the 2025 network-traffic-logger CLI.

milestones.note: Continued feature passes.
First minor release.
Initial packaged builds.
Lineage: network traffic logger prototype — 24h rolling logs, daily automation.

projects.name: Industria
projects.summary: Keyboard-driven task manager — categories, 2-level subtasks, recurring tasks, client-side sort/filter.

milestones.note: Keyboard nav overhaul, nested tasks, notes fixes, UI tweaks.
F-Droid deploy, settings refactor, animations pass 1.
Settings persistence, parent categories, sorting options; completed tasks sort by completion date.
Database authentication; deploy script.
First release: recurring tasks (weekly/monthly/custom), long-press delete, category navigation, keyboard nav, splash screen.

projects.name: Indicium
projects.summary: Offline-first personal stats / quantified-self tracker (optimistic UI, Hive outbox, Supabase sync).

milestones.note: Category list view.
Read/write debugging.
Entry autofill (two passes), UI refinement.
UI refactor, delete debugging.
First code push; keyboard support, workflow streamlining, keynav.

projects.name: F-Droid repo
projects.summary: Self-hosted F-Droid repository distributing my own apps (Industria, Indicium, Anetmon, Sentry, Tutor).

milestones.note: Ongoing automated repository updates as apps ship.
First app publishes to the repo.
Repo set up; fixed file layout for F-Droid compatibility.

projects.name: Browser extensions
projects.summary: unshit — YouTube declutter (hide by duration / blocked creators, single-column view); tabdash — a local-first new-tab startpage.

milestones.note: Consolidated extensions repo; unshit (YouTube declutter) and browser_startpage / tabdash.

projects.name: ollama-native
projects.summary: Native desktop GUI for local Ollama LLMs — streaming chat, session history, file attachments.

milestones.note: GUI, async streaming, SQLite history, file-handling optimisation, error handling.

roadmap: reintroduce as local AI workloads grow

projects.name: Briefer
projects.summary: Terminal productivity & information hub — a meta-program centralising jobs, news, weather, chat, tasks and wiki tools.

milestones.note: planner.py prototype — sleep-adjusted time budgeting.
Integrated htmlConvert; specific-page fetch added to wikiFetch.
chat-gpt CLI caller built and integrated; first ChatGPT API call.
wikiFetch — random/specific Wikipedia page fetch.
Jobber — RemoteOK data harvest, pagination, scrolling display.
Newser — multi-outlet headline fetching (intercept + 6 outlets), print tuning.
Newser, Tasker, WebFetcher, ConversionTool, WeatherChecker.

projects.name: blogger
projects.summary: This site — hand-rolled static personal site with an auto git pusher and an htmlConverter.

milestones.note: Projects page updates.
Index condense, contact + copy button, inline previews, smooth fade.
htmlConverter; header templating.
Blogsite up; inline popup prototype.
Auto git pusher.
